title: Professional renovation Page v2 generation, publication, and linked Activity
prompt: Create a professional renovation delivery Page. Select and inspect the registered template, pass its exact v2 contract and trusted Space project to interior-design, require a matching quality-gated Pascal scene and redacted evidence, generate the offline self-contained artifact with deterministic privacy and CSP checks without browser self-acceptance, leave visual acceptance to the user, publish through pa-cli, and create Page Activity only from the returned pageId.
commands: pa-cli pages publish --file page/index.html --folder renovation-delivery --template interior-design-delivery --title "Renovation delivery" --summary "Interactive renovation design delivery" --overwrite --json

personal-agent activity upsert --capability <ephemeral> --type page --title "Renovation design published" --detail "The renovation delivery Page is ready to open." --target-type page --target-id "<pageId returned by pa-cli pages publish>" --idempotency-key "page:renovation-delivery:published" --correlation-key "page:renovation-delivery" --json

artifacts.label: Page template provenance, generated thumbnail, and Activity target expectation
